home.intro: Short units of 5 to 10 minutes. No streaks, no pressure. Take your time.
home.sessionPlaceholder: Your first reading texts are being prepared.

comprehensibleInput.name: Comprehensible input
comprehensibleInput.description: Short texts just above your level. You understand most of it and pick up the rest from context.

spacedRepetition.name: Spaced repetition
spacedRepetition.description: Each word comes back right before you would forget it, at growing intervals.

activeRecall.name: Active recall
activeRecall.description: First try to remember on your own, then see the answer. That is what makes it stick.

interfaceLanguage.title: Interface language
interfaceLanguage.description: Language of menus and explanations. Your learning language is chosen separately.

A0.name: Absolute beginner
A0.description: You start from zero: first sounds, letters and words.

A1.name: Beginner
A1.description: You know a few words and simple phrases.

A2.name: Elementary
A2.description: You get by in simple everyday situations.

B1.name: Intermediate
B1.description: You follow familiar topics and can talk about your day.

B2.name: Upper intermediate
B2.description: You understand longer texts and speak fairly fluently.

onboarding.changeLater: You can change all of this later in Settings.

native.title: Which language do you know best?
native.description: We use it for translations and to explain new words.

target.title: Which language would you like to learn?
target.description: Take your pick. You can switch at any time.

interface.title: Which language should the app use?
interface.description: Menus and explanations appear in this language. Usually that is your native language.

level.title: Where would you like to start?
level.description: Not sure? Start with A0. Nothing is lost, and you can move up whenever you like.
